text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty HIGH alert fired for `inference-gateway` - 5xx error-rate crossing threshold (2.3%). Incident PGD12345. Auto-escalation in 5m. Link: https://pd.internal/PGD12345

emma (oncall): acked on PD, I'm taking initial triage. Gathering impact & relevant logs.

raj: any idea which ingress or route is the source? seeing customer 502s?

emma (oncall): grafana: error-rate spike in us-west1 and eu-west1. Top 5xx are 502 from auth-proxy and 504 from kv-proxy timeouts. No big p95 latency jump on CPU-bound services.

matt_sre: rolling restart of auth-proxy in us-west1 reduced 5xx locally. eu-west1 still elevated. Will scale auth-proxy to 6 pods in us-west to stabilize.

customer-ops: multiple customers reporting "server error" on embeddings endpoint, mostly EU-based. ETA on mitigation for them?

emma (oncall): Starting traffic shift per runbook: diverting ~10% away from eu-west1 to fallback eu2 for non-pin customers. Runbook: https://wiki/runbooks/inference-5xx. Monitoring now.

raj: logs show repeated KV cache eviction and GC spikes on kv-proxy pods in eu-west1; saw 2 OOMKills in the last 15m.

matt_sre: bumping kv-proxy memory & replicas, applying immediate change: `kubectl scale deploy/kv-proxy -n prod --replicas=5` and `kubectl set resources deploy/kv-proxy -n prod --limits=memory=1Gi` (doing gradual rollout).

emma (oncall): Customer impact estimate: ~4% of overall traffic affected, higher for EU region. Not declaring outage yet, but customer-ops please prep comms for impacted tenants.

customer-ops: on it, prepping a short advisory to impacted customers now. Will wait for a stable window before sending. :thumbsup:

raj: if kv-proxy stays stable after scaling we can remove the traffic shift. How long to observe? 8-10m to see decay.

matt_sre: agree. Also investigating yesterday's canary change to conn-timeout that may have reduced headroom under GC pressure. I'll own RCA.

emma (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 10m. Luca, quick context: elevated 5xx from kv-proxy (GC/oom), scaled kv-proxy & restarted auth-proxy pods, shifted 10% traffic away from eu-west1. PD will remain open until stable 30m.

luca: ack. I'll watch dashboards and PD. Ping me if errors reappear or traffic shift needs adjustment.

incidentbot: PagerDuty PGD12345 has been acknowledged by emma (oncall). Auto-escalation suspended.

incidentbot: PD: Alert auto-resolved (error-rate back < threshold). PGD12345 auto-closed. Please confirm local stability before final closure.

emma (oncall): closing coordination thread here. Immediate remediation: scale kv-proxy, restart auth-proxy pods, shift traffic. RCA owner: matt_sre. Customer comms owner: customer-ops. Will file postmortem once RCA complete.
